basic_info.description: Tucked into the tranquil heart of Midtown Terrace, is a bright and inviting 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom single-family home with approximately 1,900 square feet of thoughtfully designed space nestled in the middle of the city among towering cypress trees and soaring birds, offering rare serenity.  The sunlit main level features an open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area, newly refinished hardwood floors, elegant built-in bookshelves, and a beautiful Carrara marble fireplace. The seamless layout is ideal for everyday living and entertaining.    Three spacious bedrooms, each featuring custom closets, offer captivating views of the ocean and Mount Sutro, complemented by two meticulously maintained bathrooms. Downstairs, a spacious, light-filled family room with custom built-ins and a desk nook offers flexibility for work, play, or hosting guests. A two-car garage with interior access and ample storage adds convenience.    Out back, enjoy a private, landscaped retreat with mature plantings, raised garden beds, and a brick patio perfect for morning coffee or evening gatherings beneath the trees.  Midtown Terrace is a hidden gem peaceful, central, and surrounded by nature. Nearby trails through Mount Sutro and Twin Peaks offer scenic hikes, dog walks, and sweeping views.
